claims: Blockchain technology is a decentralized, distributed, and immutable digital ledger used to record transactions across a network of computers.
Blockchain technology ensures security and transparency without a central authority.
Blockchain technology groups data into cryptographically linked blocks.
No single entity owns the blockchain network.
The blockchain network is maintained by a distributed network of nodes.
Blocks are linked to the previous block using a unique identifier (hash).
A block must be validated by the network before it is added.
The network often uses methods like proof-of-work for validation.
Data in a block cannot be altered without changing all subsequent blocks.
Changing all subsequent blocks requires network consensus.
Cryptocurrency enables peer-to-peer digital payments via platforms like Bitcoin and Ethereum.
Amazon has efforts to verify product authenticity.
Smart contracts are self-executing contracts with the terms directly written into code.
